# Scientific Contract Library — permitted program extract

Status: proposed sanitized reference for SCI-FRUIT Stage A r0.2.
Original authority identities and exact extract bytes are bound by the input
manifest. This reference supplies process requirements, not numerical science.

## Charter and recovery

Scientific meaning governs implementation conformance. Stage A produces an
implementation-informed internal dossier and a separate sanitized Scope Brief.
Prior work must be recovered, classified and reused before new derivation.
The owner reviews the scope, recovery, allowed references and ambiguities.
Implementation, audits, repairs and observed outcomes stay outside the fresh
author's context. Current code does not establish a correct scientific method.

## Accepted workflow and roadmap

The pilot workflow requires reuse of adequate authority, exact permitted
references and explicit owner decisions. The downstream roadmap retains
ALIGN/AST, RTC/CAL, PTC, MAP/JINC and NOI ownership before FRUIT feedback and
later source/observing-mode inference. FRUIT cannot conceal missing upstream
authority. The approved September 6 exception permits only this conditional
core before a qualified numerical replacement.

## Later author deliverable

One canonical LaTeX core supplies scientist-facing and engineering-facing
views through notation, definitions, equations, assumptions, requirements and
edge_cases common modules. Engineering rules trace to the scientific reason;
they do not add independent science. Preserve stable IDs and a three-column
requirement/scientist-facing-source/engineering-interpretation crosswalk,
decision log and owner ledger. Contract version v and document revision r
remain distinct.

The rationale opens with a compact input/output/equation/source/status block,
leads with the physical model, ordinarily keeps its main narrative to eight
to twelve pages, and places bookkeeping in appendices or the engineering
view. Include validity, uncertainty, predictive cases and explicit unavailable
claims. Keep approved facts, known-but-unsupplied facts, open decisions,
unassessed implementation and unperformed validation distinct.

Compile both views, verify formal and crosswalk consistency, render with
Poppler and inspect every page before presenting them as complete. These are
later document checks, not permission for scientific experiments. Scientific
review is limited to three substantive rounds unless the owner reopens it;
independent consistency review and scientific-owner freeze follow separately.

The author reads only the approved files listed in the input manifest and
subsequent owner answers. Citation identities are not permission to retrieve
unlisted originals. Any unresolved scientific premise returns as a precise
owner question. Packet approval, launch and acceptance of the returned
scientific substance remain separate actions.
